answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and plants one ivory marker; fees rise per identity: 50 first, plus 8 each later one. Each epoch the beacon on the knoll names a random quarter. Each named one must show a walnut proof of work since the last flash, sealed to that signal. A missed or rented proof burns a quarter; four misses expel the identity. 1,000 fakes cost 4,046,000 against a 40,000 pool; one honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its full share.
